data.name: Kaikeyi
data.gender_notes: Kaikeyi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A heroine's name; of the Kekaya kingdom
data.long_meaning: From Kekaya, an ancient kingdom — Kaikeyī, 'princess of Kekaya'. Its root is Sanskrit kekaya (केकय). Kaikeyi, a queen in the Ramayana. Kaikeyi is a Sanskrit name meaning “A heroine's name; of the Kekaya kingdom”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kaikeyi expresses “A heroine's name; of the Kekaya kingdom”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Kekaya, an ancient kingdom — Kaikeyī, 'princess of Kekaya'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaikeyi total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
